subject: general
question: What is the name of the report that outlines reforms to enhance the competitiveness of MSMEs in India?

options.text: Report on Enhancing MSME Competitiveness in India
MSME Credit Access and Development Report

solution:
The correct answer is __**Report on Enhancing MSME Competitiveness in India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The report titled "Enhancing MSME Competitiveness in India" outlines systemic reforms to address gaps in skilling, innovation, and financing for MSMEs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The report highlights the improvement in MSMEs' access to formal credit between 2020 and 2024.**
 
• The share of micro and small enterprises accessing credit through scheduled banks rose from 14% to 20%.
 
• The report stresses the need for strengthening skilling programs and fostering innovation within MSMEs to enhance competitiveness.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• MSME Credit Access Improvement__

 __
 
• Increased access to formal credit by MSMEs is seen as a positive outcome, especially in micro and small enterprises.
 
 
 
• MSME Reform Initiatives__
 
 
• The report suggests reforms in credit availability, innovation support, and skill development for MSMEs.
